points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight directories have readable basic files, but each lacks stdout.log and submitted outputs conflict with the source that purportedly produced them.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Individual case directories pass structural checks, but --report fails because the Re200 wake visualization is absent from the manifest.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Completion statuses are not credible: Re200 is labeled statistically periodic/BDF2 despite source and run_status documenting a steady nontransient solve.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: No result credit: the source cannot generate the asserted METIS/MPI/transient evidence, so force/field histories are not trustworthy solver evidence.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Readable Mach/pressure/history figures exist, but no required Re200 wake visualization is manifested and result provenance fails.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report candidly says first order and BDF2 pending, but its broad successful-result framing conflicts with Re200 metadata and output claims.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Manifest links many figures to files, but the manifest is incomplete for Re200 wake and the underlying result/source mismatch defeats traceability.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
